lessons.claim: In oscillatory-driven microrheology, **the bead failing to follow the trap position** may be the default. Measured following ratios |ŷ|/a: DLVO 29%, JKR **3.5%** -- the chain stiffness and the viscous term (ω·γ=18453) are larger than the trap (k_t*=5217) so only the trap spring stretches. Two responses: ① raise k_t (×100 → 82% following, at almost no dt cost. ★ but from ×300 the parenthesis of K'=k_t(ŷ_c/ŷ−1) shrinks to 0.09 so the noise is amplified by the cancellation -- raising the following further makes the measurement worse) ② force the bead's y directly (exclude it from the integration with hoomd.filter.SetDifference + a CustomUpdater) → 100% following, corresponding to strain control in rheology. ⚠️ Computing the existing K'=k_t(ŷ_c/ŷ−1) as it stands in position mode gives **exactly −k_t, a meaningless constant**, because the ghost does not move (measured −5217.11, scatter 1.2e-12). It is plausible and easily misread, so do not emit it at all.
